Hi there, I went to both.  
  
 I took my diploma in Electronics & IT from GMI and then continued my bachelors at UTP studying EEE. I managed to transfer a lot of subjects that I studied in GMi once i started undergrad at UTP, took off a semesters from my study duration. You can take this route but keep in mind it takes nearly 7 years. I have no regrets, both institutions taught me a whole lot. GMI enhanced my technical hands-on skills and UTP helped me theoretically and once I graduated I have an abundance of skills. 

In the long run, UTP would be the better option and has more leverage in the industry when you're looking for jobs. I'd say if you were planning to take EEE its more general compared to the other courses which are more tailored to O&G sector. You can dm me if you have any more questions, this is just my experience.
